question_en: HKAS 36 requires an impairment loss when:
question_zh: HKAS 36要求在以下情況下確認減值損失：
options_en: Management decides to write down
Recoverable amount < carrying amount
Fair value > carrying amount
Asset fully depreciated
options_zh: 管理層決定減記
可收回金額 < 賬面金額
公允價值 > 賬面金額
資產已完全折舊
explanation_en: HKAS 36.59-60: impairment loss = carrying amount - recoverable amount. Recoverable amount = higher of FV less costs of disposal and value in use.
explanation_zh: HKAS 36.59-60：減值損失 = 賬面金額 - 可收回金額。可收回金額 = 公允價值減處置成本與使用價值的較高者。
